questions.question: Explain the percepts available to an agent in the Wumpus World and their significance in decision-making.
questions.solution_html:
• The Wumpus computer game, The agent explores a cave consisting of rooms
  • connected by passageways, somewhere in the cave is the Wumpus, a beast
  • that eats any agent that enters its room. Some rooms contain bottomless pits
  • that trap any agent that wanders into the room. The Wumpus can fall into a pit
  • too, so avoids them. Occasionally, there is a heap of gold in a room.The goal
  • is to collect the gold and exit the world without being eaten.
  • Major terms: Pits: breeze, Wumpus, stench, arrow
  • PEAS: Performance measures: ( Agent gets gold and return back safe
  • = +1000 points, Agent dies (pit or Wumpus)= -1000 points, Each move of the
  • agent = -1 point, Agent uses the arrow = -10 points) Environment:( A cave
  • with 16(4x4) rooms)Actuators: (Move forward,,Turn right/left: Rotate Shoot
  • Grab, Drop)Sensors: (Breeze,Stench, Glitter,Scream,Bump)
  • Mark Distribution: Major terms(2 marks), PEAS description(2 marks), General
  • overview of the game with or without figure( 2 marks)
  • Episodic(next episode is independent) vs sequential(current epis ode
  • determines next episode)
questions.source_exam: Official Model Question Paper (FYUGP 2024
questions.final_answer: determines next episode)
